description:
Twelve venomous animals, ranked from venom that only hurts to venom that kills in minutes, and Doug has to meet every one of them, from the platypus and the bullet ant to the inland taipan and the box jellyfish, often called the most venomous animal in the world.

Which animal should Doug try to befriend next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
